description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance scores for three conditions: “Standard”, “ClnGS (w)”, and “ClnGS”, with and without context. The horizontal axis represents the conditions, labeled “With Context” and “Without Context” in that order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks every 10 units. Three sets of bars are presented for each condition. For “With Context”, the “Standard” bar is blue and extends to approximately 52, the “ClnGS (w)” bar is also blue and extends to approximately 58, and the “ClnGS” bar is purple and extends to approximately 47. For “Without Context”, the “Standard” bar is purple and extends to approximately 42, the “ClnGS (w)” bar is purple and extends to approximately 45, and the “ClnGS” bar is purple and extends to approximately 43.  Within each condition, the three bars are positioned adjacent to each other for easy comparison. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
